title: Crescode Ensemble Template
description: Data-only description of 'which band is on stage': roster, budget and conductor rules. Pure score logic — describes the arrangement, never the sound: no effects, no mixing, no production concerns. Ranges, families and roles reuse the app vocabulary from src/shared/schema/ranges.ts. Times are ticks at 960 PPQ. This file is the documentation contract; runtime enforcement lives in src/shared/schema/ensembleTemplate.ts (validateEnsembleTemplate), which additionally enforces cross-checks that JSON Schema cannot express (roster uniqueness, role/family agreement with the app instrument table, budget vs roster size, rule targets resolving against the roster).

description.description: Intent, vibe and any conventions worth carrying (e.g. range sources for instruments not yet in the app table).

roster.description: Expected instrument tracks, one entry per track (the app keeps one track per instrument — there are no chair counts, divisi or player numbers anywhere in a template).

rules.description: Conductor rules as checkable constraints over the score. A rule references families or roster roles and carries typed params; internal consistency is validated now, score enforcement arrives with the score checker.

rosterEntry.description: One expected track. role is lowerCamelCase; when the role exists in the app instrument table (INSTRUMENTS), family must agree with it. low/high are an optional range hint for instruments not yet in the app table, written as scientific pitch (C4 = 60); low must not exceed high.

budget.description: Arrangement governor. A layer is a functional role, not an instrument — shared vocabulary: lead, pad, ostinato, tremolo, counterline, bass, fill, stab, percussion, color, sub, riser, texture. Energy is computed from the score, windowed per beat: E = occupancy x velocity, where occupancy = sounding roster tracks / roster size and velocity = mean note velocity of sounding tracks / 127 (calibration: solo pizz pp ~ 0.05-0.1, section mf pad ~ 0.3-0.4, tutti ff ~ 0.85-0.95). The clamp's upper bound is a HARD constraint (score checking rejects beyond it); the lower bound is a SOFT directive (report 'texture below floor', never reject).

maxLayers.description: Maximum concurrent layers (functional roles). Enforced against the roster: cannot exceed the number of roster tracks.

mode.description: Intended use. Default 'validate'. Round 1 stores and consistency-checks this; execution comes later.

params.description: Typed per rule type. overlapAvoid: { actor: familyOrRole, against: familyOrRole, windowTicks: 1-7680 } — actor onsets must stay clear of against onsets by the window (e.g. woodwinds in the windows between brass stabs). octaveDoubling: { policy: allowed | climaxOnly | forbidden, energyThreshold? (0 < t <= 1, required iff climaxOnly) }. fillGating: { fills: familyOrRole, duringRestsOf: familyOrRole, minGapTicks: 1-7680 } — fills enter only during rests of the target (call-and-response). unisonOrnament: { tracks: rosterRole[] (1-64), transforms: (graceNote | slide | turn)[] , divergence?: 'perInstrument' } — heterophonic doubling with per-track ornamentation.
